newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa seeks to boost ship registrations.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa seeks to boost ship registrations.

text.p: South Africa's cabinet on Wednesday approved draft legislation aimed at encouraging ship owners to register ships under the South African flag, the Department of Transport said.
The main object of the Ship Registration bill was to establish South Africa as "a maritime business location," the department said in a statement.

"The bill relaxes existing qualification requirements for certain classes of ships by introducing the principle of majority ownership and by allowing the registration of ships leased to South African-based operators," the statement said.
It said this did not apply to fishing vessels, which would have to be wholly owned by South Africans.
The bill would not allow South African registration to become a flag of convenience, the transport department said.

"The department recognises that the successful development of a South African ships' register depends on creating a business environment conducive to domestic ship-owning and operating activities," the statement said.
"The department is keen to see remaining impediments and disincentives removed and is investigating the obstacles to ship financing and the tax environment for ship owners."
